sloka: विद्राव्य शरवर्षेण वर्षा वायुरिवोत्थितम् ।पाञ्चजन्यं महाशङ्खं प्रदध्मौ पुरुषोत्तमः ।। ७.७.९ ॥
transliteration: vidrāvya śaravarṣeṇa varṣā vāyurivotthitam ।pāñcajanyaṁ mahāśaṅkhaṁ pradadhmau puruṣottamaḥ ।। 7.7.9 ॥

translations.english: Having dispersed the rain of arrows with his own arrows, just as wind disperses rain, the best among men blew his great conch, Panchajanya.
